name: Alex
message: I'm trying to keep a tiny herb garden.

name: Sunny
message: Tiny garden sounds like a good place for very dramatic basil. What did you plant?

name: Alex
message: Basil and mint. The mint lives in its own blue pot.

name: Sunny
message: Separate quarters for the mint. Sensible. Is the basil doing well?

name: Alex
message: It was drooping yesterday. I moved it away from the hot window.

name: Sunny
message: Let's see how it does there before we declare a basil emergency.

name: Alex
message: I said blue pot earlier but it's green. The watering can is blue.

name: Sunny
message: Green pot for the mint. Blue watering can. I had those swapped.

name: Alex
message: The basil looks better today. I like checking the plants after dinner.

name: Sunny
message: I'm glad it perked up. A small after-dinner garden round sounds lovely.

name: Alex
message: I might sketch the leaves this weekend. No big project.

name: Sunny
message: Just a few leaves and a pencil. We can keep it small.
